events.reason: Q-60: local_branch returns kUnsupported (2 == 1) for (paper alignment, exact height) at k = 2..31 although D-11 does not use the alignment (unit params, unit Mode B local, differential vs Dijkstra, property Def 4.1/threshold SCCs). Q-61: parameter_log gives 'paper'/'lambda' instead of 'paper (ignored under D-11)'/'lambda (ignored under D-11)'. The kUnsupported message for D-11 names the Sec 5.4 formulas / D-8 instead of D-11. The existing unit test 'an unsupported instance is a failure' expected kUnsupported for (paper, exact height) at k = 31; per the lead's Q-60 decision (2026-11-27) that expectation applies to the grid only, so the exact-height half was replaced by the D-11 precondition N >= 2 (k = 1). New tests for the fixed constants (both directions) and separator exponents above 64 already pass (test-only gaps).
